summary.business_type: Financial Web Application & Calculator (US 50 States, Canada GST/HST, VAT)
summary.current_status: Rankings are in active recovery following early-autumn adjustments. GSC data confirms 17,534 impressions and 32 clicks over the last 28 days with average position climbing from 45.8 to 18.6 overall. High-intent state pages with enriched content (New York at pos 9.4 and Connecticut at pos 10.9) are already ranking on Google Page 1.
top_findings: Content Enrichment Disparity: The two states with custom deep guides (New York: 2,409 words, Connecticut: 1,525 words) hold Google Page 1 rankings (pos 9.4 and 10.9), while 48 templated state pages (633-996 words) linger in positions 15-40.

Google Search Console Indexation Success: 100% of sampled regional and root pages passed GSC inspection with 'Submitted and indexed' status, verified Mobile crawler fetch, and valid Breadcrumb rich results.
SEO Drift Confirmed Positive: Title tags have been tightened (eliminating redundant brand repetition), H1 spacing glitch resolved, and schema expanded from 5 to 7 structured blocks.

AI & Agentic Readiness High: llms.txt is 100% valid under Lighthouse standards (3,010 bytes), primary content is 100% server-rendered (7,683 words without JS), and robots.txt explicitly welcomes GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended.

Duplicate Endpoint Equity Leak: /how-it-works and /faq return HTTP 200 with identical homepage content and canonical tags to root rather than permanent 301 redirects, diluting crawl budget and equity.
quick_wins: Implement 301 redirects from /how-it-works and /faq to /#how-it-works and /#faq to concentrate all historical query equity into the primary homepage URL.
Fix Schema name glitch on New York state page from 'New York Sales Tax Calculator' to 'New York Reverse Sales Tax Calculator' for 100% entity consistency.

Enrich the top 5 high-impression state pages (Texas: 618 impr, California: 454 impr, South Carolina: 345 impr, Florida: 311 impr, Arizona: 299 impr) using the proven New York/Connecticut depth playbook.
Expand lean international hubs (Canada: 723 words, UK VAT: 437 words, Germany VAT: 374 words) with local invoice compliance rules and reverse VAT refund workflows.
Standardize sitemap.xml trailing slash formatting to perfectly mirror server canonical endpoints.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 100% Server-Side Rendered (SSR) content via Next.js Turbopack — 7,683 words delivered on initial HTML payload without client JS requirement
Edge global delivery via Vercel CDN with sub-50ms TTFB and HTTP/2 gzip compression
Enterprise security headers: Strict-Transport-Security (max-age 63072000; includeSubDomains; preload), nosniff, and SAMEORIGIN X-Frame-Options
All 79 sitemap URLs verified indexed with zero sitemap parse errors in Google Search Console
Clean HTTP 404 response codes for non-existent routes (soft-404 tests passed)

findings.title: Duplicate URL Handlers on /how-it-works and /faq
findings.description: /how-it-works and /faq return HTTP 200 with 6,706 words identical to the homepage and self-referential canonical pointing to root. While canonical tags prevent indexation conflicts, returning HTTP 200 wastes Googlebot crawl frequency.
findings.recommendation: Deploy permanent HTTP 301 redirects in next.config.mjs from /how-it-works to /#how-it-works and from /faq to /#faq.

findings.title: Canonical & Sitemap Trailing Slash Uniformity
findings.description: Sitemap URLs list URLs without trailing slash while canonical link tags in HTML include trailing slashes. Harmonizing these avoids unnecessary redirect reconciliation.
findings.recommendation: Standardize all URLs in sitemap.xml to match exact canonical URLs.

categories.name: Content Quality & Depth
what_works: Homepage contains 7,737 words of exhaustive mathematical, tax law, and accounting guidance with an Information Density score of 1.0 and zero filler
New York state page upgraded to 2,409 words covering NYC 8.875% combined rate, MTA surcharge, clothing exemptions, and local audit guidelines
Connecticut state page enriched to 1,525 words, directly propelling it to Google Page 1 (Position 10.9 with 1,566 impressions)
Official citations and outbound links to IRS, Tax Foundation, Sales Tax Institute, CRA, and OECD establish high E-E-A-T trust

findings.title: 48 US State Pages Remain on Standard Templated Footprint
findings.description: 48 of 50 state pages average between 633 and 996 words with recurring boilerplate paragraphs. GSC data proves that enriched states (NY and CT) achieve Page 1 ranks, while templated states lag on Pages 2-4 despite high search interest.
findings.recommendation: Execute Phase 2 content expansion across the top 10 highest-traffic states (Texas, California, Florida, South Carolina, Arizona, Pennsylvania, Illinois, Ohio, Georgia, North Carolina), adding county-level local brackets, food/clothing exemptions, and real receipt examples.

findings.title: International VAT & Canada Hubs Thin Content Gap
findings.description: Canada (/canada: 723 words) and international VAT pages (UK: 437 words, Germany: 374 words, Australia: 313 words) lack the depth required to compete for high-volume overseas accounting queries.
findings.recommendation: Expand international country guides with cross-border invoice rules, reverse-charge VAT mechanisms, and Canadian provincial tax blend breakdowns (GST + PST/HST/QST).

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Primary H1 tags clearly aligned with target intent across all audited pages
Homepage title tag successfully refined to 'Reverse Sales Tax Calculator: Find Pre-Tax Price Free' (53 characters), removing brand redundancy
Comprehensive OpenGraph and Twitter card metadata including dynamic OG images with calculated rate overlays
Logical heading hierarchy across desktop and mobile viewports with 1 H1, 25 H2s, and 44 H3s

findings.title: Internal Link Equity Anchor Distribution
findings.description: Internal links from state pages back to the homepage frequently use generic anchor text rather than keyword-rich contextual anchors like 'free reverse sales tax calculator'.
findings.recommendation: Refine internal footer and contextual breadcrumb links to use descriptive anchors.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Homepage deploys 7 distinct valid JSON-LD schemas: Organization, WebSite, WebApplication, HowTo, Person, FAQPage, and ImageObject
Rich breadcrumbs valid and verified by GSC across state and international pages
FAQPage schema correctly reflects 6 high-value questions and answers, unlocking search result accordion features

findings.title: WebApplication Schema Entity Name Discrepancy on New York Page
findings.description: The WebApplication schema on /us/new-york declares name as 'New York Sales Tax Calculator' instead of 'New York Reverse Sales Tax Calculator'.
findings.recommendation: Update the JSON-LD schema builder to inject 'Reverse Sales Tax Calculator' uniformly across all state applications.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Next.js optimized responsive image delivery serves WebP format at just 46.7 KB for the primary diagram
Clean DOM architecture with zero layout-shifting ads or intrusive modal scripts
Mobile viewport meta tag configured properly with disabled horizontal scroll and compliant touch targets

findings.title: CSS & Script Chunk Preload Optimization
findings.description: Multiple small Turbopack chunk files are loaded asynchronously. Bundling or inlining critical paths can shave an additional 15-25ms off mobile render times.
findings.recommendation: Ensure Next.js experimental optimizePackageImports is enabled for UI icon libraries.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO & Agentic)
what_works: 100% compliant llms.txt file (3,010 bytes) passing Lighthouse agentic checks
Explicit crawler access configured in robots.txt for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and CCBot
Content structured with direct definition boxes, formula proofs, and worked mathematical examples highly quotable by LLMs and AI Overviews

findings.title: Content-Signal Preference Header
findings.description: Robots.txt does not currently declare the optional Content-Signal header (search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no).
findings.recommendation: Consider adding Content-Signal metadata if specific AI training restrictions are desired.

categories.name: Images & Visual Assets
what_works: Homepage formula infographic has descriptive alt text and ImageObject structured data
All 4 viewport screenshots (Desktop, Laptop, Tablet, Mobile) render cleanly without overlaps or text clipping
Next.js responsive picture element automatically handles dynamic device sizing

findings.title: State-Specific Visual Infographics Missing
findings.description: State pages currently rely purely on text and interactive form inputs without visual breakdown graphics for state vs county tax splits.
findings.recommendation: Generate lightweight SVG or WebP regional rate cards for the top 10 states to capture Google Image Search traffic.
